# OutagesReport Package

2026-1-12 Jiwon Bae and Hillary Rodriguez

Please follow below instructions to get started on using our package!

## Overview

We are creating a package that takes in outage data and generates a
report consisting of different graphs and functions.

We provide functions for common utility metrics such as SAIDI - System
Average Interruption Duration Index, SAIFI - System Average Interruption
Frequency Index, and CAIDI - Customer Average Interruption Duration
Index.

We also provide a variety a visuals so users can understand daily,
weekly, monthly, and yearly outage trends as well as borough-level
outage trends.

Currently, the package takes in a CSV file. One of the key assumptions
we make is that the data used when calling this package has a specific
format, as defined in our data file.

Our package was designed to be used by utilities to get a better
understanding of their data in a quick, easy, and convenient way.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

### Install from GitHub (recommended)

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("MatildaBae/outages_report")
```

### Install from local source (development)

If you have cloned the repository locally, run the following from the
package root directory (the folder containing `DESCRIPTION`):

``` r
devtools::install()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Instructions

### 1. Load the package

``` r
library(outagesreport)
library(readr)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 2. Load outage data

You can either use the **example dataset included with the package** or
provide your own CSV file.

#### Option A: Use example data (recommended for first use)

``` r
df <- readr::read_csv(package_data_path())
```

#### Option B: Use your own data

``` r
df <- readr::read_csv("path/to/your/outage_data.csv")
```

#### Required columns

At minimum, your data should include:

- `STARTDATE`
- `RESTDATE`
- `OUTAGEFLAG`
- `TOTALCUSTAFFECTED`
- `XBORO` (for borough-level and event chain analyses)

Dates must be parseable by
[`lubridate::ymd_hms()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/lubridate/man/ymd_hms.html).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 3. Compute reliability metrics

``` r
SAIDI_calc(df)
SAIFI_calc(df)
CAIDI_calc(df)
```

These functions return numeric values representing standard utility
reliability indices.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 4. Generate daily summaries

``` r
daily <- summarize_daily_outages(df)
```

This produces a daily-level summary with outage counts, customer impact,
restoration times, and momentary event statistics.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 5. Create plots

``` r
plot_daily_outages(daily)
plot_daily_customers(daily)
plot_daily_total_duration(daily)
plot_daily_avg_restoration(daily)
```

All plotting functions return `ggplot` objects and can be customized
further.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 6. Analyze event chains (optional)

Event chains identify outages occurring within short time gaps (5–10
minutes) within the same borough.

``` r
chains <- identify_event_chains(df)
chain_summary <- summarise_event_chains(chains)

plot_chain_counts_by_boro(chain_summary)
plot_chain_time_of_day(chains)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 7. Explore weekly, monthly, and seasonal trends (optional)

``` r
prepared <- prepare_outages(df)

weekly  <- summarise_weekly_outages(prepared)
monthly <- summarise_monthly_outages(prepared)

plot_outages_per_week(weekly)
plot_outages_per_month(monthly)
```

Seasonal summaries:

``` r
plot_seasonal_outage_frequency(prepared)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Typical workflow

``` r
df <- readr::read_csv(package_data_path())

daily <- summarize_daily_outages(df)

SAIDI_calc(df)
plot_daily_outages(daily)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Data assumptions

- Input data follows a standardized outage schema
- Dates are interpreted in UTC
- Example data is included for demonstration and testing purposes

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_season()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/add_season.md)
  : Add a season label based on outage day
- [`CAIDI_calc()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/CAIDI_calc.md)
  : Calculate CAIDI (Customer Average Interruption Duration Index)
- [`filter_daily_range()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/filter_daily_range.md)
  : Filter a daily outage summary by date range
- [`filter_monthly_range()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/filter_monthly_range.md)
  : Filter a monthly summary by date range
- [`filter_weekly_range()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/filter_weekly_range.md)
  : Filter a weekly summary by date range
- [`identify_event_chains()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/identify_event_chains.md)
  : Identify outage event chains within boroughs
- [`missing_nonzero()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/missing_nonzero.md)
  : Return only variables with non-zero missingness
- [`missing_summary()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/missing_summary.md)
  : Summarize missing values by variable
- [`package_data_path()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/package_data_path.md)
  : Path to example outage CSV
- [`plot_chain_counts_by_boro()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_chain_counts_by_boro.md)
  : Plot chain event counts by borough
- [`plot_chain_percent_by_boro()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_chain_percent_by_boro.md)
  : Plot percent of outages in chains by borough
- [`plot_chain_time_of_day()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_chain_time_of_day.md)
  : Plot time-of-day distribution of chain outages (polar clock)
- [`plot_chain_time_of_day2()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_chain_time_of_day2.md)
  : Plot time-of-day distribution of chain outages (histogram)
- [`plot_customer_hours_monthly()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_customer_hours_monthly.md)
  : Plot customer-hours lost per month
- [`plot_customer_hours_weekly()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_customer_hours_weekly.md)
  : Plot customer-hours lost per week
- [`plot_daily_avg_restoration()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_daily_avg_restoration.md)
  : Plot average restoration time (minutes) per day
- [`plot_daily_customers()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_daily_customers.md)
  : Plot total customers affected per day
- [`plot_daily_outages()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_daily_outages.md)
  : Plot total outages per day
- [`plot_daily_pct_momentary()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_daily_pct_momentary.md)
  : Plot percent momentary events per day
- [`plot_daily_total_duration()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_daily_total_duration.md)
  : Plot total outage duration (minutes) per day
- [`plot_missing_bar()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_missing_bar.md)
  : Plot missing counts by variable
- [`plot_missing_upset()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_missing_upset.md)
  : Plot missingness pattern via UpSet plot
- [`plot_outages_per_month()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_outages_per_month.md)
  : Plot outages per month
- [`plot_outages_per_week()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_outages_per_week.md)
  : Plot outages per week
- [`plot_outage_trend_loess()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_outage_trend_loess.md)
  : Plot daily outage trend using LOESS smoothing
- [`plot_seasonal_outage_frequency()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_seasonal_outage_frequency.md)
  : Plot seasonal outage frequency
- [`plot_troublecode_top_monthly()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/plot_troublecode_top_monthly.md)
  : Plot monthly outages by top trouble codes
- [`prepare_daily_ts()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/prepare_daily_ts.md)
  : Prepare daily outage time series (tsibble)
- [`prepare_outages()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/prepare_outages.md)
  : Prepare outage records with derived time fields
- [`prep_missing_df()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/prep_missing_df.md)
  : Prepare data for missingness summaries
- [`remove_outliers()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/remove_outliers.md)
  : Identify non-outlier values using the IQR rule
- [`SAIDI_calc()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/SAIDI_calc.md)
  : Calculate SAIDI (System Average Interruption Duration Index)
- [`SAIFI_calc()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/SAIFI_calc.md)
  : Calculate SAIFI (System Average Interruption Frequency Index)
- [`summarise_event_chains()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/summarise_event_chains.md)
  : Summarise chain events by borough
- [`summarise_monthly_outages()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/summarise_monthly_outages.md)
  : Summarise monthly outages
- [`summarise_seasonal_outages()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/summarise_seasonal_outages.md)
  : Summarise outages by season
- [`summarise_troublecode_monthly()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/summarise_troublecode_monthly.md)
  : Summarise trouble codes monthly
- [`summarise_weekly_outages()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/summarise_weekly_outages.md)
  : Summarise weekly outages
- [`summarize_daily_outages()`](https://matildabae.github.io/outages_report/reference/summarize_daily_outages.md)
  : Summarize daily outages
